**NZ Inflation Expectations Ease**
New Zealand’s long-term inflation expectations eased in the fourth quarter, according to Bloomberg Markets. This adds to signs that a fresh wave of higher fuel prices is not becoming embedded in the economy. Evidence is based solely on the RSS headline and description; the full article was not fetched.
